results.check: All configured portfolio, services, packages and FAQ entries render without runtime errors in a simulated DOM
Exact draft prices, package names, WhatsApp enquiry amounts and approval notices
All four graphic filters and hiding unavailable filter categories
Every portfolio image maps to its original; open/close handlers and focus restoration (dialog API simulated)
Image viewer previous/next, wraparound and arrow-key handlers
Mobile-menu open, close on navigation, Escape and ARIA state
All rendered anchors resolve to page sections, existing images or the approved contact destinations
Unique element IDs, hero copy and prohibited terminology scan of page text
Every rendered image and local script/style reference exists
Invalid form rejected; valid fields and Unicode encoded correctly; blocked-popup fallback; truthful status (window.open intercepted, no network request)
Active navigation follows section order and back-to-top toggles (scroll positions simulated)
Approval flag removes draft labels only when explicitly set true
All 20 portfolio originals match recorded SHA-256 source hashes
No fetch/module dependency preventing ordinary local-file loading
All image files decode, previews preserve proportions, form labels and a single primary heading are present
Optional metadata utility emits absolute social URLs and canonical metadata; repeat execution is stable

limitations: CSS layout and the five requested viewport widths were not visually tested.
Native dialog Escape behavior, focus trapping, native FAQ keyboard behavior and browser popup policy require a real-browser check.
No messages were sent and external app availability was not tested.
file:// browser navigation was blocked by the available browser policy; local browser installation did not complete.
